generate_status_grid_image: run the script to generate a colored grid PNG from status.json showing problem statuses
customize_grid_colors: edit the COLORS dictionary to change the color scheme for each problem status category
adjust_grid_layout: modify COLS, ROWS, CELL_W, and GAP variables to change the grid dimensions and spacing
update_problem_categories: edit status.json to add or remove problem indices from world_record, former_record, worse_than_record, or matched_optimal categories
change_total_problems: update the TOTAL_PROBLEMS constant to include more or fewer problems in the grid visualization
